about: Auto-rejoin after a terminal drop (P14, 2026-11-13). Byte-identical in desktop crates/app/src/testvectors/rejoin.json (the owner; rejoin_rule.rs) and web src/features/calls/testvectors/rejoin.json (rejoinRule.ts). healthy = the call ran 45 s or more (it resets attempts to 0 first); completed = the join had completed (the call server said Connected); attempts = auto-rejoins already made in this run of drops; the cap is maxAttempts. auto = recoverable and not hung up and attempts (after the reset) < maxAttempts and (healthy or completed). 5-7 (launch-gate 2026-11-14): ONE automatic rejoin (maxAttempts 1): a second drop shows Connection lost with Try again, no loop.

cases.name: a healthy call (45 s+) drops: rejoin
P14: a young call whose join had completed drops: one rejoin
a join that never completed: no rejoin (a JOIN problem)
5-7: a second young drop after the one auto-rejoin: no rejoin (Connection lost + Try again)
5-7: a drop after a rejoin that never connected: no second try
the 1-try cap: a later young drop parks on Rejoin
a healthy call resets the count: rejoin again
the server said leave (kick, duplicate identity, deleted room): never
the user hung up while the drop was in flight: never
